DML.SELECT: SELECT graphic_group_id as "graphicGroupId", element_type_id as "elementTypeId", element_id as "elementId", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.vms_graphic_groups_elements WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.vms_graphic_groups_elements (graphic_group_id, element_type_id, element_id, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:graphicGroupId, :elementTypeId, :elementId, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM conf.vms_graphic_groups_elements WHERE element_type_id = :elementTypeId AND graphic_group_id = :graphicGroupId AND element_id = :elementId
